Obiara nnim da ko a Awurade bɛsane aba
1 # Mat 24.36 Na nna no ne mmerɛ no deɛ, anuanom, ɛnhia mo sɛ wɔtwerɛ brɛ mo. 2#Mat 24.42-44; 2 Pe 3.10; Adi 3.3; 16.15 Ɛfiri sɛ mo ara monim yie, sɛ Awurade da no bɛba sɛ owifoɔ ba anadwo. 3#Yer 6.14; Mat 24.39 Na berɛ a wɔbɛka sɛ: Yɛwɔ asomdwoeɛ ne ahotɔ no, ɛnneɛ mpofirim na ɔsɛeɛ bɛba wɔn soɔ sɛ awoko ba ɔbaa a ɔnyem soɔ, na wɔrennya kwan nnwane. 4Na mo deɛ, anuanom, monni esum mu, na ɛda no abɛto mo sɛ owifoɔ. 5#Rom 13.12; Efe 5.8 Mo nyinaa moyɛ hann mma ne adekyeeɛ mma; yɛnyɛ anadwo anaa esum dea.
6Enti mommma yɛnnna sɛ wɔn a aka no, na mmom momma yɛnwɛn, na yɛn ani nna hɔ. 7Ɛfiri sɛ wɔn a wɔda da anadwo, na wɔn a wɔborɔ boro anadwo, 8#Efe 6.14-17 na yɛn a yɛyɛ adekyeeɛ dea yi, momma yɛn ani nna hɔ, na yɛnhyɛ gyidie ne ɔdɔ nkataboɔ ne nkwagyeɛ anidasoɔ sɛ dadeɛ kyɛ. 9Ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn anyi yɛn amma abufuo, na mmom ɔyii yɛn sɛ yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo nti yɛmmɛnya nkwagyeɛ. 10#Rom 14.8-9; 1 Te 4.14 Ɔno na ɔwu maa yɛn sɛ yɛnyane oo, yɛwu oo, yɛne no ntena nkwa mu. 11#Yuda 20 Enti montutu mo ho fo na obiara mpia ne yɔnko, sɛdeɛ moreyɛ no ara.
Afotuo ahodoɔ
12 # 1 Ko 16.18 Na yɛsrɛ mo, anuanom, sɛ monhunu wɔn a wɔyɛ mo mu adwuma na wɔdi mo so mpanin Awurade mu, na wɔkasa kyerɛ mo, 13na mommu wɔn papaapa ɔdɔ mu, wɔn adwuma nti. Montena asomdwoeɛ mu. 14#2 Te 3.15 Afei yɛtu mo fo, anuanom, sɛ monkasa nkyerɛ wɔn a wɔnam basabasa, monkyekyere wɔn a wɔn akoma atuo werɛ, monsɔ wɔn a wɔyɛ mmerɛ mu, montɔ mo bo ase mma nnipa nyinaa. 15#Mmb 20.22; Rom 12.17; 1 Pe 3.9 Monhwɛ na obi amfa bɔne antua obi bɔne ka, na mmom monni deɛ ɛyɛ akyiri daa, mo ne nnipa nyinaa ho. 16#Flp 4.4 Momma mo ani nnye daa; 17#Luk 18.1; Rom 12.12; Kol 4.2 monnnyae mpaebɔ da! 18#Efe 5.20 Monna ase ade nyinaa mu, na yei ne deɛ Onyankopɔn pɛ Kristo Yesu mu wɔ mo ho. 19#1 Ko 14.30; 14.39 Monnnum honhom no, 20#1 Ko 14.1 monnte adiyisɛm atua! 21#1 Ko 14.29; 1 Yoh 4.1 Monsɔ ade nyinaa nhwɛ, na monsɔ deɛ ɛyɛ no mu den. 22Monyi mo ho mfiri bɔne su nyinaa ho.
23Na ɔno asomdwoeɛ Nyankopɔn no ara nte mo ho koraa, na ɔnhwɛ mo honhom ne mo kra ne mo nipadua so mu a ɛho remma asɛm biara yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo ba mu. 24#1 Ko 1.9; 2 Te 3.3 Ɔnokwafoɔ ne deɛ wafrɛ mo no, ɔno nso na ɔbɛyɛ.
Nkradie
25Anuanom, mommɔ mpaeɛ mma yɛn. 26#1 Ko 16.20 Momfa mfeano kronkron nkyeakyea anuanom nyinaa. 27Mehyɛ mo Awurade mu sɛ, momma wɔnkenkan nwoma yi nkyerɛ anuanom nyinaa. 28Yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo adom nka mo.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na nna no ne mmerɛ no deɛ, anuanom, ɛnhia mo sɛ wɔtwerɛ brɛ mo. Ɛfiri sɛ mo ara monim yie, sɛ Awurade da no bɛba sɛ owifoɔ ba anadwo. Na berɛ a wɔbɛka sɛ: Yɛwɔ asomdwoeɛ ne ahotɔ no, ɛnneɛ mpofirim na ɔsɛeɛ bɛba wɔn soɔ sɛ awoko ba ɔbaa a ɔnyem soɔ, na wɔrennya kwan nnwane. Na mo deɛ, anuanom, monni esum mu, na ɛda no abɛto mo sɛ owifoɔ. Mo nyinaa moyɛ hann mma ne adekyeeɛ mma; yɛnyɛ anadwo anaa esum dea.
Enti mommma yɛnnna sɛ wɔn a aka no, na mmom momma yɛnwɛn, na yɛn ani nna hɔ. Ɛfiri sɛ wɔn a wɔda da anadwo, na wɔn a wɔborɔ boro anadwo, na yɛn a yɛyɛ adekyeeɛ dea yi, momma yɛn ani nna hɔ, na yɛnhyɛ gyidie ne ɔdɔ nkataboɔ ne nkwagyeɛ anidasoɔ sɛ dadeɛ kyɛ. Ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn anyi yɛn amma abufuo, na mmom ɔyii yɛn sɛ yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo nti yɛmmɛnya nkwagyeɛ. Ɔno na ɔwu maa yɛn sɛ yɛnyane oo, yɛwu oo, yɛne no ntena nkwa mu. Enti montutu mo ho fo na obiara mpia ne yɔnko, sɛdeɛ moreyɛ no ara.

Na yɛsrɛ mo, anuanom, sɛ monhunu wɔn a wɔyɛ mo mu adwuma na wɔdi mo so mpanin Awurade mu, na wɔkasa kyerɛ mo, na mommu wɔn papaapa ɔdɔ mu, wɔn adwuma nti. Montena asomdwoeɛ mu. Afei yɛtu mo fo, anuanom, sɛ monkasa nkyerɛ wɔn a wɔnam basabasa, monkyekyere wɔn a wɔn akoma atuo werɛ, monsɔ wɔn a wɔyɛ mmerɛ mu, montɔ mo bo ase mma nnipa nyinaa. Monhwɛ na obi amfa bɔne antua obi bɔne ka, na mmom monni deɛ ɛyɛ akyiri daa, mo ne nnipa nyinaa ho. Momma mo ani nnye daa; monnnyae mpaebɔ da! Monna ase ade nyinaa mu, na yei ne deɛ Onyankopɔn pɛ Kristo Yesu mu wɔ mo ho. Monnnum honhom no, monnte adiyisɛm atua! Monsɔ ade nyinaa nhwɛ, na monsɔ deɛ ɛyɛ no mu den. Monyi mo ho mfiri bɔne su nyinaa ho.
Na ɔno asomdwoeɛ Nyankopɔn no ara nte mo ho koraa, na ɔnhwɛ mo honhom ne mo kra ne mo nipadua so mu a ɛho remma asɛm biara yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo ba mu. Ɔnokwafoɔ ne deɛ wafrɛ mo no, ɔno nso na ɔbɛyɛ.

Anuanom, mommɔ mpaeɛ mma yɛn. Momfa mfeano kronkron nkyeakyea anuanom nyinaa. Mehyɛ mo Awurade mu sɛ, momma wɔnkenkan nwoma yi nkyerɛ anuanom nyinaa. Yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo adom nka mo.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
